lead_raw_text:
The structure of Gd8Cr4Bi4 (reduced formula Gd2CrBi) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi centers with 13 geometric neighbors, Cr centers with 9 neighbors, and Gd centers in several environments, including a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 neighbors. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among the 13-vertex Bi, 9-vertex Cr, and 12-vertex Gd coordination polyhedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
